build_pix2pix_zero_pipeline: build a StableDiffusionPix2PixZeroPipeline from a pretrained Stable Diffusion checkpoint for image editing
invert_image_to_latents: invert a real image to latents using the pipeline invert method with a prompt and DDIMInverseScheduler
generate_caption_for_image: generate a caption for an input image using the pipeline generate_caption method with BLIP
get_text_embeddings: get text embeddings for a list of prompts using the pipeline get_embeds method
edit_image_with_cross_attention_guidance: edit an image by passing source and target embeddings with cross attention guidance to the pipeline
